facts.text: Tim has been reading stories from travelers to plan his next adventure.

evidence.quote: I've been reading cool stories from travelers from around the world. I'm using it to plan my next adventure.

facts.text: Tim read a story about two hikers who trekked through the Himalayas.

evidence.quote: I read a few of them. One of them is about two hikers who trekked through the Himalayas, sounds awesome!

facts.text: The story about the Himalayan trek mentioned challenging terrain, altitude sickness, and bad weather.

evidence.quote: The book mentioned that the trek was tough but worth it, with challenging terrain, altitude sickness, and bad weather.

facts.text: The story about the Himalayan trek also mentioned that the hikers saw amazing sights and were motivated by the experience.

evidence.quote: they made it and saw amazing sights - it really motivated me.
